record_type_quote: The purpose of this study was to replicate Smith and Pederson’s (1988) findings examining the prediction of mother-infant attachment and then extend this work to the prediction of father-infant attachment.

targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study was to replicate Smith and Pederson’s (1988) findings examining the prediction of mother-infant attachment and then extend this work to the prediction of father-infant attachment.
targets.outcome_quote: Results revealed that for both mothers and fathers, parental behavior in the No-toy situation neither differed according to attachment classification, nor could accurately predict the quality of mother-infant or father-infant attachment relationships.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract identifies replication of prediction of attachment and reports that behavior could not predict attachment. Target citation details are limited to the abstract; reference list unavailable.
